title: Untitled (Divided Cityscape)
description: Horizontal composition split into two contrasting halves: a red urban left panel with white crosses, green palms, and patchwork collaged squares, and a dark right panel with purple palms, a gold heart, and white Keith Haring-style figures. Turquoise graffiti lettering runs across the lower foreground.
composition: bilateral split with collaged urban panorama
